name: percentage-field
title: Percentage field
description: A percentage you can type or nudge: it understands 12,5 and 12.5%, stays in range, and can show what the rate comes to on a base amount.
docs: value and onValueChange speak a plain number (12.5), or null while the field is empty, always inside min and max (0 and 100 unless you say otherwise) and rounded to precision (2 unless you say otherwise). It reads 12,5, 12.5 and 12.5% alike, so the percent sign is the field's own and a typed one is dropped. The arrow keys add or take away step, Shift or Page Up and Page Down make it ten times as much, and Ctrl or Cmd with Home and End go to the limits (Home and End themselves move the caret, as in any field). With a min below zero the field asks a phone for the full keyboard, because a number pad has no minus. A number that was out of range is brought in when the field is left, and a quiet line says so (Capped at 100%.). With base (minor units, 48000 is 480.00) and currency it writes the sentence under the field as the number changes, in the currency's own decimals, and a screen reader hears it once the number is settled; labels renames every phrase. The input is a spinbutton with the value, the limits and the sentence as its text. name adds a hidden input with the number, and id lands on the input, so a label's htmlFor focuses it (with no id, aria-label or aria-labelledby the field is named Percentage).
